business_problem: IBM needed to reduce the time employees spent on repetitive work across HR, procurement, IT, supply chain, tax, and sales while creating a repeatable enterprise blueprint for scaling AI, automation, and hybrid-cloud productivity improvements.
solution_summary: IBM treated itself as Client Zero and used an enterprise execution framework to embed AI, automation, and hybrid cloud into everyday workflows across the company. The transformation centered on the IBM watsonx portfolio, supported by agile two-week delivery cycles, outcome measurement, and executive sponsorship so teams could launch minimum viable products and expand them after measurable wins. Across functions, IBM combined AI agents, workflow automation, and connected data to reduce ticket loads, resolve employee questions, streamline procurement, improve supply-chain visibility, accelerate finance processing, and assist sellers with research. The architecture combines watsonx.ai, watsonx Orchestrate, Watson Discovery, watsonx Code Assistant, Turbonomic, Apptio, and watsonx.data into a reusable enterprise operating model rather than a single departmental bot.

data_flow: Function-specific operational data and employee requests flow through AI-enabled workflows built on the watsonx portfolio, where agents answer questions, automate steps, and route tasks; knowledge services and data platforms expose the right context, and the outputs return to employees across HR, IT, procurement, sales, finance, tax, and supply-chain processes.
business_outcome: IBM reports billions in productivity gains, broad reduction of manual work, better employee self-service, improved logistics and procurement efficiency, faster finance cycles, and stronger seller productivity through a coordinated AI-and-automation operating model.
